page: Microsoft Azure E64as_v4 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the EASv4 server family. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 7763 processor with 64 vCPUs, 32 physical cores, and a base clock speed of 3.525 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. It features 512.0 GB of RAM, equating to 8.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 885 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

In benchmark evaluations, the E64as_v4 demonstrates strong multi-core and memory performance. Its PassMark memory score ranks in the top tier (top 10%), while stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression fall into the top 25%. For database operations, the server registers strong performance in PassMark database tests and Redis SET operations, processing 62.62 million operations per second. Large-block uncached memory read/write bandwidth and single-threaded compression tasks perform in the average tier.

While the server excels in memory-intensive workloads and multi-threaded processing, it exhibits limitations in large-scale machine learning tasks. Large (70B) LLM text generation speed is weak, falling into the bottom 25%, though smaller model text generation remains strong. The hardware profile is highly cost-efficient for memory-heavy applications that do not require GPU acceleration. The E64as_v4 is well-suited for large relational databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, data caching layers, and multi-threaded software compilation.
